tour.aboutTour: Wa jolo i ct.js! Wot man matidi ni obi nyuti jami ma ki tiyo kwede i editor man, wek inge kit me yubu ct.js ki yubu jami manyen.
tour.helpPanel: Mukwongo, nen bute ma ki lwongo ni sneaky bute ni. Pire tek tutwal pi pwonyo ct.js!
tour.helpPanelTabs:
Kabedo man gwoko waraga weny ki pwony pi ct.js ki jami ne, ki bene tye ki coc aryo pi rekod ni.

Global notepads ki poko i kin yub ki ki gwoko i cim ni. Coc me yub ni ki gwoko i yub ni.
tour.projectResources: I kare ni, yub weny tye ki jami ma pat pat. Kit jami weny tye ki dul ne. Wek wanenu jami ma pire tek loyo.
tour.tabTextures: Textures obedo cal ma ki twero tic kwede pi jami ma itwero tic kwede (ma ki lwongo ni Copies), backgrounds, ki jami ma pat pat. Kit ma ki yubu kwede pe timo gin mo kiken ento tye gin ma mite.
tour.tabTexturesImport: Itwero kelo jami ma ki coyo ki i karatac ni...
tour.tabTexturesGallery: ...onyo kelo jami ma ki yubu con ki i ot ma ki gwoko iye buk.
tour.tabTexturesClipboard: Bute man keto cal ma ki kwanyo ki i karatac me keto cal. Ber tutwal ka itye ka tic ki dano ma loko cal!
tour.tabTexturesPlaceholders: Itwero bene yubu cal ma yot ki jami tic eni.
tour.tabTemplates: Kit ma ki yubu kwede jami ni ki tiyo kwede me yubu kopi — jami ma ki keto i rwom ni. Gin mo keken ma twero tic i ct.js ki yubu ki i kin jami ma ki yubu ni. Gi tiyo ki jami ma itye kwede, ki in i gonyo kit me tuku ni kun i yubu jami ma time iye. Ka dong iyubu gin ma ki nyutu, ki in itwero timo ne kene i yub me yubu gin ma ki coyo.
tour.tabRooms: Gin mukene ma pire tek tye pi ot. Ot ni ki twero lwongo ni rwom onyo kabedo ma i keto iye kopi ni. Ot ni bene twero bedo ki yub gi ki jami ma gu kato ki iye.
tour.tabSounds: Winye, atamo, en aye gin ma nen maber loyo.
tour.tabSoundsImport: Itwero yubu dwan manyen ki bute man...
tour.tabSoundsGallery: ...kelo gi ki i ot ma ki gwoko iye dwan...
tour.tabSoundsRecord: ...onyo bene mako gi ki dwan malongo ni!
tour.tabInterlude: Ki tye kabedo aryo pi jami ma rwom ne lamal.
tour.tabUI: UI tab doro coc ki kit coc. Keto coc ni kacel ki tuku ni pire tek wek onen maber i kin jami ma ki tiyo kwede. Kit me coc tye ki gin ma ki neno me yubu kit me coc. Gin bene gi yubu coc me yubu nying ma kit meno i tuku.
tour.tabFX: Gin ma ki lwongo ni FX tab tye ki gin ma ki lwongo ni particle systems — jami ma nyutu jami ma twero balo jami, tango, iro, kot, ki jami eni weng.
tour.tabProject: Eni tye pi jami ni! Ento ma pat ki jami eni, yub ni bene tye ki jami mapol ma ki keto me nyutu, keto nying, keto i bok ki jami mukene.
tour.tabProjectModules: Ct.js tye ma ki yubu, ki yub ni romo mito jami mukene ma ki twero keto kany.
tour.tabProjectModuleDocs: Karatac weny ma mako jami ma ki tiyo kwede ki twero nongo ne kany.
tour.tabMainMenu: Ct.js kikome tye ki jami mapol ma ki twero yero, ma ki gwoko i menu ne madit.

tour.helpPanelReminder: Ki dong pi iwek wi owil i kom karatac ma ki yubu iye! Wa miini tam ni omyero i tyeko pwony ma ki miini ma pwod pi icako yub ni keni.

licensePanel.whoOwnsGamesQ: Nga ma tye ki tuku ma ki yubu i ct.js?
licensePanel.whoOwnsGamesA: In ki in keken. Ct.js pe tye ki twero i kom gin mo kiken ma i yubu i yoo mo keken.
licensePanel.sellingGamesQ: Atwero cato tuku ma ki yubu i ct.js?
licensePanel.sellingGamesA: Ada, itwero cato tuku ni ki yub mukene, coko kony, ki tic ki tuku ni i yub me cato wil mukene.
licensePanel.possibleFeesQ: Myero a cul pi ct.js? Ct.js obi bedo ma ki culu nino mo acel?
licensePanel.possibleFeesA: Ku, ct.js tye me nono ki obi bedo kit meno kare weny. Pe tye ki cul mo ma ki kano calo Unity onyo Unreal Engine ma mito ni i cul inge nongo wel cente mo. Ct.js tye ma ki yabo, ki kadi bed ni tye jami ma ki culu pire, gin ma itye kwede i kare ni obi bedo nono labongo cul mo kiken. Itwero cwalo kony onyo bedo latic, kadi bed kumeno! Obi konyowa me culu banya ki miyo ct.js bedo maber!
licensePanel.useInStudioQ: Atwero tic ki ct.js i ot kwan onyo gang kwan?
licensePanel.useInStudioA: Ada, pingo ku? Ct.js tye pi tic pa ngat acel acel, tic me cato wil, tic me pwony, ki jami mukene. Pe i turo cik, ber?
licensePanel.attributionQ: Amito ni aket ct.js onyo luyub ne? Atwero juku lanyut ne i kom gin ma ki keto iye jami?
licensePanel.attributionA: Itwero juku ct.js logo, ma calo coc me tuku ni dong tye ki jami ma miite.
licensePanel.attributionAAssets: Labol mogo ki lanyut mogo twero bedo ki jami ma miite ni ki lok iye, ento dong ki keto iye.
